KijaniKiosk CI Pipeline - Credential Audit Report
Date: 2026-05-11

===================================================
1. Jenkinsfile Secret Scan
===================================================

Command:
grep -i "password\|secret\|token\|key" Jenkinsfile

Result:
No matches found.

Conclusion:
No hardcoded credentials present in Jenkinsfile.

---------------------------------------------------

===================================================
2. Repository-wide Secret Scan
===================================================

Command:
grep -R "password\|secret\|token\|key" .

Result:
No matches found in source code.

Conclusion:
No credentials stored in application or scripts.

---------------------------------------------------

===================================================
3. Git History Secret Scan
===================================================

Command:
git log -p | grep -i "password\|secret\|token\|key"

Result:
No matches found.

Conclusion:
No sensitive information present in commit history.

---------------------------------------------------

===================================================
4. Build Logs Inspection
===================================================

Checked Jenkins build logs for:
- NEXUS credentials
- Environment variable leakage
- npm publish authentication output

Result:
All credentials are masked via Jenkins credentials binding.
No sensitive values visible in logs.

Conclusion:
Credential masking is functioning correctly.

---------------------------------------------------

===================================================
5. .npmrc Verification
===================================================

Check:
- .npmrc is created during pipeline execution
- .npmrc is deleted immediately after publish step
- .npmrc is NOT committed to repository

Result:
- Created dynamically in pipeline ✔
- Deleted within same stage ✔
- Not present in repo ✔

Conclusion:
No persistent credential storage exists.

===================================================

FINAL ASSESSMENT:
✔ No credentials found in codebase
✔ No credentials found in git history
✔ No credentials exposed in build logs
✔ Credentials only exist transiently during pipeline execution
✔ Secure credential handling confirmed via Jenkins credentials binding
